mapper.select: SELECT p.post_id AS postId, p.user_id AS userId, u.name, p.title, p.content, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments WHERE post_id = p.post_id) AS commentCount, p.view_count AS viewCount, p.like_count AS likeCount, p.created_at AS createdAt FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.user_id

SELECT p.post_id AS postId, p.user_id AS userId, u.name, p.title, p.content, p.view_count AS viewCount, p.like_count AS likeCount, p.created_at AS createdAt FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.user_id WHERE p.post_id = #{postId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO posts (post_id, user_id, title, content) VALUES (post_seq.NEXTVAL, #{userId}, #{title}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT p.post_id AS postId, p.user_id AS userId, u.name, p.title, p.content, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments WHERE post_id = p.post_id) AS commentCount, p.view_count AS viewCount, p.like_count AS likeCount, p.created_at AS createdAt FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.user_id WHERE p.title LIKE '%' || #{keyword} ||'%'
